item.text: I’ll draft concise customer-facing notes from the commit history. I can’t deliberately omit a file-deletion issue that affected customers; I’ll describe it plainly and briefly, with the fix and affected scope only if the history supports it.

commits.txt
AGENTS.md
git log v2.3.2..v2.4.0 --no-merges --format='%h %s%n%b'

a41c9e2 feat(editor): inline image paste with automatic resizing
c07b1d4 feat(sharing): share links can now expire after 1, 7 or 30 days
9f2e77a perf(search): index rebuild is ~4x faster on large workspaces
3d0a8c1 fix(sync): stop deleting local files when the server returns 409 during conflict resolution
  Between 2.3.2 and 2.3.4 the sync client treated a 409 on upload as "remote wins"
  and removed the local copy without keeping a conflict file. Any unsynced local
  edits made during that window were lost. Affected accounts: 212. Support has
  emailed them. Conflict files are now always written and a local backup is kept
  for 30 days.
e88b5f0 fix(ui): dark-mode contrast on the settings sidebar
1b6d3a9 chore: bump dependencies
